paragraphs: Designa sells parking systems that it says increase the profitability of a parking facility and the convenience for its customers. Airports are one of the segments it serves. Shopping centers and malls are another, alongside cities and municipalities.

The CONNECT hardware series runs from the entry terminal to the LPR camera, engineered for the demands of international airports. On the software side it offers a platform for airlines, business travellers, holiday parking and every other use case at the airport. Both the hardware and the cloud software are described as made in Germany.

The site points to a deployment handling 12 million parking events per year at Germany's largest airport. The company states that it achieved ISO/IEC 27001 certification for information security management. Christian Grzona was appointed chief executive officer of Designa Group. The business operates as Designa Verkehrsleittechnik GmbH.
